prompt: Here's the verify handler for our OTP (email/SMS one-time code) endpoint. It backs onto Redis to cap wrong guesses at MAX_ATTEMPTS before locking the user out. Under load we're seeing two things: attackers are getting away with far more than MAX_ATTEMPTS guesses, and every so often a user's attempt counter never expires and they stay locked out indefinitely. Walk through the code below, tell me exactly why both symptoms happen, and how you'd fix it.
